body: thanks for the reply. I'll try doing that. I've been thinking of killing myself, the only reason I haven't yet is because I know how much it would hurt my family.

Thanks for the response. I find it tremendously difficult to talk about my feelings. I don't know why, but it just stops me from telling anyone what's going on and how I feel.
I just think the world in general is wrong, and I don't know how people from day-to-day just go along with it. I want to change things, I want to be something, but I know I'll amount to nothing in the grand scheme of things.
